realization.stochastic_source: zero-mean Gaussian tensor source xi_ab with covariance equal to the stress-tensor noise kernel
realization.domain: linearized Einstein-Langevin; low curvature; scales much larger than Planck length

critical_interpretation: C2 is stronger than mean semiclassical C1 because it includes stress-tensor noise and linked dissipative/retarded response, but the metric remains classical stochastic in the declared realization. Noise alone is not a quantum-gravity certificate.
